podcast.body: This album significantly angered the country music establishment, leading to The Byrds being booed off the stage at the Grand Ole Opry. It marked Parsons' controversial foray into country with a rock band. "Later, he will join the birds whose sweethearts of the rodeo in 1968 so greatly upset the country music establishment that the birds were booed off the stage at the Grand Ole Opry."
